author: A

components.title: Count exactly 3 women, 1 man
components.what: Compute C(6,3)*C(5,1) for committees with exactly 3 women and 1 man.

components.title: Count exactly 4 women
components.what: Compute C(6,4) for committees with exactly 4 women and 0 men.

components.title: Sum cases for total
components.what: Add the two case counts to get committees with at least 3 women.

log.author: A
log.draft:
To choose a committee of 4 with at least 3 women, split into two disjoint cases:

**Case 1: Exactly 3 women, 1 man**
C(6,3) × C(5,1) = 20 × 5 = 100

**Case 2: Exactly 4 women, 0 men**
C(6,4) × C(5,0) = 15 × 1 = 15

**Total:** 100 + 15 = 115

FINAL: 115
